name: v0.3.0
body:
### :rocket: Features
- Implemented item metadata
- Implemented code detection support
- Implemented color detection support
- Add source and source_icon fields for all history rows
- Introduce database migration system
- Move database logic to new Rust-based structure
- Create universal types shared between Rust and TypeScript
- Add macOS download support
- Move items to top when copied again
- Add logging for debugging

### :bug: Bug Fixes
- Fix YouTube thumbnail formatting
- Resolve "too many files" watch error
- Prevent duplicate item insertion
- Fix empty history items being added

With this release I implemented the option of a custom hotkey with a settings page accessible through the tray menu as well as finally supporting macOS by replacing rdev the previous hotkey handler with global-hotkey which works flawlessly on all platforms.

## ♻️ Changes

With this release I implemented a new clipboard handler thanks to [tauri-plugin-clipboard](https://github.com/CrossCopy/tauri-plugin-clipboard) for making such a good crate which actually works cross-platform.

## ♻️ Changes
- new clipboard handler
- support for files
- fixed image cut off
- load history in chunks of 50
- new logo
- new icons for all the types
